target.title: fix(acp): defer session snapshot update after newSession/resumeSession result
target.body:
<!--
Optional linked context:
Related: Codex review comments on PR #109973
-->

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where ACP clients could receive `session_info_update` and `available_commands_update` notifications before the `session/new` or `session/resume` JSON-RPC response, causing the client to observe incomplete session state on the wire. The deferred notifications could also fire after `session/close` completed, sending stale session_info_update notifications for sessions the client had already closed.

## Why This Change Was Made

`setTimeout(0)` defers initial lifecycle notifications past the synchronous handler return and response serialization, establishing a deterministic event-loop boundary that guarantees the JSON-RPC result reaches the wire before any notification. A `hasSession` guard at the top of each deferred callback skips stale notifications when `closeSession` has already removed the session from the store, closing the close-before-timer race window. Boundary: `src/acp/translator.ts` lifecycle handlers only — Gateway protocol layer, session storage, prompt handling, and other ACP handlers are unchanged.

## User Impact

ACP clients can now rely on receiving the `session/new` and `session/resume` JSON-RPC result before any `session/update` notification over the wire, and will no longer receive stale notifications for sessions they have already closed. No user-visible API or response shape changes.

## Evidence

### NDJSON Wire-Level Transcript — newSession

Real `ndJsonStream` + `AgentSideConnection` connects `AcpGatewayAgent`; capture transform intercepts every NDJSON byte the agent writes. 4 lines in arrival order:

```
[0] {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"result":{"protocolVersion":1,"agentCapabilities":{...},"agentInfo":{"name":"openclaw-acp","title":"OpenClaw ACP Gateway","version":"2026.7.2"},"authMethods":[]}}
    ↑ initialize RESPONSE

[1] {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"result":{"sessionId":"c90b4221-...","configOptions":[...],"modes":{...}}}
    ↑ session/new RESULT ← arrives FIRST

[2] {"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"session/update","params":{"sessionId":"c90b4221-...","update":{"sessionUpdate":"session_info_update",...}}}
    ↑ session_info_update NOTIFICATION ← arrives AFTER response

[3] {"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"session/update","params":{"sessionId":"c90b4221-...","update":{"sessionUpdate":"available_commands_update","availableCommands":[]}}}
    ↑ available_commands_update NOTIFICATION
```

**Ordering proof**: response index [1] < notification index [2]. ✓

### NDJSON Wire-Level Transcript — resumeSession

```
[0] {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"result":{"protocolVersion":1,"agentCapabilities":{...},"agentInfo":{"name":"openclaw-acp","title":"OpenClaw ACP Gateway","version":"2026.7.2"},"authMethods":[]}}
    ↑ initialize RESPONSE

[1] {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"result":{"configOptions":[...],"modes":{"currentModeId":"adaptive","availableModes":[...]}}}
    ↑ session/resume RESULT ← arrives FIRST

[2] {"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"session/update","params":{"sessionId":"agent:main:order-proof","update":{"sessionUpdate":"session_info_update","title":"Order proof","updatedAt":"2026-07-19T02:35:54.422Z","_meta":{"sessionKey":"agent:main:order-proof","kind":"direct","spawnedWorkspaceDir":"/tmp"}}}}
    ↑ session_info_update NOTIFICATION ← arrives AFTER response

[3] {"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"session/update","params":{"sessionId":"agent:main:order-proof","update":{"sessionUpdate":"available_commands_update","availableCommands":[]}}}
    ↑ available_commands_update NOTIFICATION
```

**Ordering proof**: response index [1] < notification index [2]. ✓

### Close-Before-Timer Regression Tests

Two new tests verify the close race guard:

```console
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/acp/translator.lifecycle.test.ts

 ✓ |acp| src/acp/translator.lifecycle.test.ts (17 tests) 265ms
     ✓ newSession suppresses deferred notifications when closeSession runs before the timer fires
     ✓ resumeSession suppresses deferred notifications when closeSession runs before the timer fires
```

Both tests call `newSession`/`resumeSession`, immediately call `closeSession` before the deferred timer fires, flush the timer queue, and assert `sessionUpdate` is never called.

### Full Test Run

```console
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/acp/translator.lifecycle.test.ts src/acp/translator.lifecycle.ndjson-proof.test.ts

 ✓ |acp| src/acp/translator.lifecycle.test.ts (17 tests) 265ms
 ✓ |acp| src/acp/translator.lifecycle.ndjson-proof.test.ts (2 tests) 11687ms
     ✓ newSession: JSON-RPC response line precedes session/update notification in NDJSON stream
     ✓ resumeSession: JSON-RPC response line precedes session/update notification in NDJSON stream

 Test Files  2 passed (2)
      Tests  19 passed (19)
```

### Lint Fix

3x `eslint(no-promise-executor-return)` violations in `translator.lifecycle.test.ts` fixed by wrapping `setTimeout` in a block body:

```diff
- await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 0));
+ await new Promise((resolve) => { setTimeout(resolve, 0); });
```

### Environment

- OS: Linux
- Node: 24.15.0
- Branch: `fix/acp-bridge-session-order`
- OpenClaw: `2026.7.2`

### What Was Not Tested

Real Gateway WebSocket connection flow (requires Gateway infrastructure). The NDJSON proof covers ACP stdio/in-memory transport only — it uses the real `ndJsonStream` byte serialization path but not a real ACP client process or WebSocket transport.
